key_insight: Embedding trained neural networks into optimization models enables data-driven constraints and objective approximations, but smaller, sparser networks can make optimization more tractable.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can incorporate learned relationships into optimization while balancing model fidelity against formulation size and solve time.
method: Train neural networks to represent empirical constraints or approximate nonlinear objectives.
Embed the trained networks into an optimization formulation.
Apply practical modeling considerations, including network size and sparsity, to improve tractability.
evidence_signal: A case study validates the tutorial’s practical guidance and highlights benefits of smaller, sparser networks; the abstract reports no quantitative results.
watch_item: Embedded networks can produce optimization models that are too large or slow to solve.
paper_title: Constraint Learning by Optimizing over Trained Neural Networks: A Pragmatic Tutorial
